name: Dream Neighborhood — Schools
description: Schools tab: school district, quality index, and real per-school federal safety data (NCES CCD + U.S. DOE CRDC), nationwide, on Postgres + PostGIS.

PGSSLMODE.description: Force SSL for the managed Postgres connection.

EMBED_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Shared secret for the embeddable-widget admin (/embed-admin) and /api/embed/admin. Leave unset to disable the admin.

DN_ENVIRONMENT.description: Set to 'staging' to retire the customer dashboard and let Dream Neighborhood configure the School Explorer. Anything else, including unset, means production. See docs/DN_INTEGRATION.md.

DN_ORIGIN.description: Dream Neighborhood origin. Defaults to staging.dreamneighborhood.com on staging and app.dreamneighborhood.com otherwise.

DN_INGEST_API_KEY.description: Key for pushing School Explorer usage and upgrade requests to Dream Neighborhood. Minted per environment with `python manage.py create_ingest_key` on the DN side; a staging key does not work against production. The push does nothing at all while this is unset.

CRON_SECRET.description: Guards /api/cron/*. Unset means the endpoints are open.
